channel.title: Namibia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Namibia, every source cited.

item.title: Namibian man claims murder charges are false
item.description: Teodor Shipanga, 49, told the Windhoek High Court he has no knowledge of killing a colleague and stealing N$2.5 million.

item.title: Namibia hosts world autism congress
item.description: Windhoek will gather international experts and advocates from November 3-5 to discuss autism support.

item.title: Namibia minister announces fuel price hike
item.description: Petrol prices will increase by N$2 per litre and diesel by N$3 per litre starting in November.

item.title: FMD costs Namibia N$150 million weekly
item.description: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreak disrupts trade across SADC, threatening farmers' incomes and export markets.

item.title: Namibia private sector credit grows N$5.84 billion
item.description: Businesses and households borrowed more in nine months, but inflation erodes real gains.
